:::{#def-real-coordinate-space}
#### The set $\reals^p$

For a [positive integer](https://morrison-lab.github.io/mcs/number-systems.html#def-positive-integer) $p$,
$\reals^p$ is the set of all
[column vectors](#def-column-vector) of length $p$
whose entries are [real numbers](https://morrison-lab.github.io/mcs/number-systems.html#def-real-numbers).

:::
